tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows elevated hemoglobin and markedly increased platelet distribution width, with a slightly low hematocrit. Other parameters are within normal limits. The findings may suggest hemoconcentration or possible underlying myeloproliferative process; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
